title: Improved ride, safety, and menu usability
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on perceived improvements to ride, suspension, engine performance, safety, and interface usability, though many excerpts are too fragmentary to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise improved engine performance, suspension comfort, and road holding in comparison with earlier models.

negative.summary: The negative review sample is limited and appears inconsistent, so there is insufficient evidence to identify a concrete complaint beyond a broadly referenced ride-related improvement.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention improvements to safety, driving feel, earlier-model comparisons, menu searching, and general areas for improvement without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are short or fragmentary, which limits confidence in interpreting the specific issue and sentiment.
The cluster mixes vehicle dynamics, safety features, and infotainment/menu usability, so it is not a single tightly coherent subject.
The lone negative example conflicts with its wording, so the negative theme cannot be summarized confidently from the provided evidence.
